description: Return a checkout link to top up one existing answering line with a prepaid pack. Use only after the owner asks to buy and approves the price from get_answering_line_offer; get_answering_line supplies line_id and billing_mode. Choose line_minutes, line_outcomes or legacy calls to match that line. For a new line use set_up_answering_line; other products use their own product endpoint. The owner pays on Stripe; this tool never sees a card or charges it directly. Needs billing:checkout and ownership of the line; rate limited per account. Returns checkout_url, product, pack, price_cents, units, unit and payment instructions. Nothing renews.

line_id.description: An existing line_id from get_answering_line owned by this account.

pack.description: Pack id from get_answering_line_offer; legacy calls use calls10 or calls50.

product.description: Match billing_mode: minutes → line_minutes, outcomes → line_outcomes, legacy calls → calls.

name: buy_line_pack
title: Top up an existing answering line
